goal: Triage every ticket in seconds, send anything risky to a human, and never send a reply we can't back with a past resolution.

approach.title: Cheapest step first
approach.text: Classifiers and retrieval settle most tickets. The LLM only writes drafts the gate already judged safe.

approach.title: Safety is decided by code
approach.text: Calibrated scores, explicit rules and deterministic checks. Never the model grading itself.

approach.title: Every part earns its place
approach.text: Each component is kept only if a metric on the locked holdout says it helps.
